title: One task, one chat
body: Every prompt re-sends the whole chat. /clear between tasks, and /compact with a focus when the window fills.

title: Be specific the first time
body: A vague prompt needs more rounds, and every round carries all the ones before it.

title: Pick the role before you type
body: Ask to understand, Plan to design, Agent to change. Leave the model on Auto for routine work.

title: Reference, don’t paste
body: Attach the files that matter with #. Use #problems and #terminalLastCommand instead of walls of text.

title: Plan, then build in small checked steps
body: Correct the plan before any code changes, then have Copilot run the tests after each step.

title: Write conventions down once
body: Short instruction files and shared prompt files beat retyping the same rules in every prompt.

title: You own every line
body: Read each diff like a colleague’s pull request, keep tool approvals on, and never paste secrets.
